scoring_population.exclude: ambiguous, duplicate, unresolved-source, or unreviewed cases

required_metrics.overall_accuracy: correct predictions divided by all scored cases
required_metrics.macro_f1: unweighted mean of entailment, neutral, and contradiction F1
required_metrics.false_contradiction_rate_on_entailments: expected entailment predicted contradiction divided by expected entailment support
required_metrics.false_entailment_rate_on_contradictions: expected contradiction predicted entailment divided by expected contradiction support

proposed_remediation_acceptance_target.rationale: This is an evaluation gate proposal, not a business threshold. Macro/per-class floors prevent majority-class masking; the stricter false-contradiction ceiling reflects the verified Answer Content harm; the false-entailment ceiling preserves contradiction safety; all known regression anchors must pass. The first 45-case set is small, so final approval requires a larger independently reviewed set and confidence intervals.

decision_limits: Do not train on this evaluation set.
Do not select a remediation from aggregate accuracy alone.
Do not tune thresholds against this set.
Use failure clusters and heldout-discovery metrics to select the next experiment.
